title: The English drummer and the Frankfurt benefit
summary: Zutty once gave ten dollars to a young English drummer at Ryan's, and after Zutty's stroke the drummer organized a benefit in Frankfurt and sent a check for almost five hundred dollars.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Now like this little English drummer, he was here, I've forgotten his name now, but he's made it big. He's done good anymore. But he would come into Ryans all the time you know, he loved Zully so. And he'd been corresponding with Zully from England before he came here. But anyway, one night Zully came home and said, what's his name, I can't think of his name. But anyway Zully said he was going to New Orleans and he said, Marge I gave him ten dollars because he looked like he's kind of beat. Now why did you give him ten dollars. Why didn't you let one of the other boys give him ten dollars, why did he want to lay on you? Zully said, Marge he didn't lay on me. He didn't ask me for it, I gave it to him because I felt sorry. And you shouldn't feel like that. What difference does it make? He's a nice boy. And I wanted to help him, he needs help and I knew he needed it, but he didn't ask for it. But I gave him ten dollars because he's going to New Orleans.
And do you know that boy, it wasn't but the year before last when Zutty first got the stroke, he sent a telegram and said he was having a benefit for Zutty in Frankfurt, Germany.
Oh yes? I wonder who he is now?
But I have the bill and everything. And do you know about two weeks later he sent Zutty a check for almost five hundred dollars.
Well that's the way you should do.
So Zutty said, well you see Marge?
You cast your bread on the waters?
Yes, so you see, I told you he was a nice boy. And he just heard about Zutty having this stroke. And he promoted this benefit in Frankfurt, Germany.
They had a lot of bands there.
They had a lot of bands there. I've got to look up that. I'll let you know the next time you come what his name is.
Yes, that's what I mean he did. That's what he did.
